verdict.rationale: Helicone has a documented public REST API: REST reference pages such as POST /v1/request/query with curl examples, and a live OpenAPI spec at docs.helicone.ai/swagger.json. Its OpenAI-compatible AI Gateway API, webhooks and an llms.txt docs index also make it drivable programmatically by agents. Missing for 10: evidence that management surfaces (prompts, alerts, sessions configuration) are covered by the REST API beyond request querying, and independent hands-on corroboration of using the REST API.
